_comment: CAMPAIGN base config (CAMPAIGN_SPEC.md Section 1). Every locked parameter lives here; campaign/genconfig.py overrides ONLY the factor values (target strengths/positions, cost_ratio, seeds, solver N_t, output paths) and never edits this file in place. Positions here are the 60-degree baseline at range d = 0.5 m; the generator recomputes them per angular-separation condition.

environment._comment_time_limit: Seconds. Decision (<= 4.2 s at the top of the criterion grid) plus post-commitment travel (<= ~19 s at v = 0.05) fit with a wide margin; a run that hits this limit is CENSORED, not scored.
environment._comment_ticks_per_second: Arena clock. MUST equal the agent's ticks_per_second (Section 1: they alias otherwise). dt = 0.1 s.

sensory_stream._comment: Section 2. The white sensory noise lives HERE, upstream of the model; eta_rate below is 0 accordingly, and the DDM's c becomes sqrt(2)*white_rate = 0.0495. `seed` is set per replicate by the generator as H(campaign_seed, 'sensory', dQ, dtheta, replicate) -- the criterion is deliberately absent so the sweep is paired. frozen_sd = 0 per Section 1.2: a frozen bias imposes an accuracy ceiling Phi(A/s_beta) that flattens every curve.

arena_0._comment_side: Square arena spans [-side/2, side/2]. side = 2 fits every angular-separation condition: at dtheta = 150deg the targets sit at y = +-0.483 plus a 0.025 object radius, which overflows the default side = 1 (and the arena would RE-SAMPLE the target to a random position rather than fail).
arena_0._comment_random_seed: Set per replicate by the generator as the INTERNAL seed H(campaign_seed, 'internal', dQ, dtheta, c_e, replicate); the model's own RNG descends from it.

static_0._comment: The BETTER target by construction; scored as correct downstream.

movable_0._comment_linear_velocity: m/s, LOCKED (Section 1): physically plausible, T_max = r0/v spans 2.6-8.7 s across the angular grid.
movable_0._comment_angular_velocity: deg/s. NOT the template's 10: the minimum turn radius is v/omega, and at the locked v = 0.05 a 10 deg/s plant gives a 0.29 m turning circle -- the agent then ORBITS the target outside the 0.05 m termination radius forever (measured: stable closed orbit, min distance 0.134 m, up to 19/20 replicates censored at dtheta = 150). Arrival scoring requires v/omega << termination radius; 120 deg/s gives 0.024 m. Post-commitment motion only -- the pre-decision heading is the bisector the agent already faces, and percepts are heading-independent (attention_mode none), so decisions are untouched.

embodied_pure_ddm._comment_eta_rate: REQUIRED to be 0 under sensory_stream.mode 'shared': the noise is drawn upstream, and the stream's white_rate is handed back to the DDM as the noise SCALE c on both channels.
embodied_pure_ddm._comment_n_sub: Section 1.3: integration step c*sqrt(dt/n_sub) = 0.0039, below the smallest useful boundary. The two lowest criterion points remain discretisation-limited and are flagged as such in the output.
embodied_pure_ddm._comment_cost_ratio: The swept criterion (factor C); overridden per condition.
embodied_pure_ddm._comment_z_min: DELIBERATELY far below the historical 0.05: Section 1.3 requires the chance-level end of the curve to be measured (flagged, with the realised crossing log-odds recorded), and a 0.05 floor would replace the policy's z ~ 0.003 at c_e <= 0.1 with the floor itself. 1e-4 keeps the numerical guard without masking any grid point.

bellman._comment_T_max: null = r0/v from the onset geometry, per condition.
bellman._comment_T_max_check_factor: Off for the bulk campaign; the precompute pass (campaign/precompute_tables.py) runs the 1.5x horizon check once per condition instead of once per replicate.
bellman._comment_N_t: Overridden per condition to ceil(T_max / 1e-3): dt = 1 ms everywhere on the grid (the boundary converges as O(sqrt(dt))).
bellman._comment_terminal: forced_choice | halt_sprt (BELLMAN_KNOWN_A_TERMINAL_HALT_DESIGN). forced_choice: commit at arrival whatever you believe, z(T_max) = 0 -- the terminal collapse; undecided mass becomes near-chance guesses and decision times clip at T_max, which caps the frontier's accuracy asymptote at large c_e. halt_sprt: at arrival the agent halts at the midpoint (v = 0) and keeps integrating at delay rate halt_cost_rate against the flat threshold z_halt (= myopic z* at c_tau = c_h), so z(T_max) = z_halt, accuracy tends to 1 - ER(z_halt), and decision times extend past arrival by ~D(z_halt) on average -- RECHECK time_limit at the top of the c_e grid before a halt campaign: a run that hits the limit mid-halt is censored. Known-|A| model only. The table cache key includes the mode, so both frontiers can share one cache.
bellman._comment_halt_cost_rate: c_h: delay rate while halted. 1.0 is the physical value (halted = zero progress recovers nothing). Only read under terminal: halt_sprt; other values are sensitivity knobs, and c_h < 1 voids the halt-only-at-arrival domination lemma.
bellman._comment_table_cache_dir: Set by the generator to the campaign's shared table cache (Section 7.3). null = solve in-process, the historical behaviour.

results._comment_snapshots_per_second: Equal to the tick rate: per-tick rows. At this horizon a run is <= 600 ticks, so the per-run archive stays small; the filesystem load is controlled by chunk aggregation (Section 7.4), not by the logging cadence.
